scripts.prebuild: cd modules && rm -rf 0* 1* && rsync -a --exclude '.esphome/' --exclude 'secrets.yaml' ../../modules/0* ../../modules/1* ./ && find . -name README.md -exec sh -c 'mv "$1" "${1%README.md}index.md"' _ {} \; && rm -rf ../docs ../software && rsync -a --exclude '.esphome/' --exclude 'secrets.yaml' --exclude 'node_modules' --exclude 'dist' --exclude 'pnpm-lock.yaml' ../../docs/ ../docs/ && rsync -a --exclude '.esphome/' --exclude 'secrets.yaml' --exclude 'node_modules' --exclude 'dist' --exclude 'pnpm-lock.yaml' ../../software/ ../software/ && find ../docs ../software -name README.md -exec sh -c 'mv "$1" "${1%README.md}index.md"' _ {} \; && rm -rf ../public/modules ../public/docs ../public/software && for full in $(find ../../modules ../../docs ../../software -type d \( -name diagrams -o -name assets -o -name home-assistant-config -o -name ha-config \) | sed 's|^\./\./||'); do rel="${full#../../}"; mkdir -p "../public/$(dirname "$rel")" && rsync -a --exclude '*.md' "$full/" "../public/$rel/"; done
